prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "design a game HUD". The fixture has a convincing happy-path interface but also loading, empty, error, keyboard/focus, and narrow-viewport states that expose ownership and accessibility mistakes. The acceptance boundary is game-spatial-interface: Design situated game, simulation, immersive, or spatial interaction under attention and performance constraints. The adjacent embedded-interface discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: VR runtime capability map for head pose, controller ray, hand pinch, and seated recenter
wrist-triggered inventory with 12 items and current fixed-world spawn bug
seated/standing play-space fixtures and left/right handedness
comfort/performance verification constraints for target headset frame rate
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift

requiredEvidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
explicit unavailable, simulated, inferred, or stale evidence labels

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual game-spatial-interface boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=visual-interface-design,frontend-engineering; children=three-d-graphics; near-neighbor=embedded-interface), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Design situated game, simulation, immersive, or spatial interaction under attention and performance constraints.
Establish play/operation goals, camera/world context, devices, distance, comfort, and frame budget.
The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: HUD chrome competes with primary action.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Situated interaction contract; Engine/device runtime verification; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
